title: Meta
description: Schema for the .shapes/meta.yaml file. Tracks the protocol version and the next available ID for each node type, ensuring unique ID allocation across the shapes graph.

version.description: Semantic version of the Shapes Context Protocol used by this project.

next_ids.description: Monotonically increasing counters for the next available ID of each node type.

NextIds.title: NextIds
NextIds.description: ID counters for each node type. Each value represents the next ID to be assigned when creating a new node of that type.
